reason: Proof #5: a 118-task multi-agent stress proof answering C4 (long projects) and C5 (multi-agent). One shared Forge project implemented by 4 concurrent agent processes across 9 subsystems (foundation, contract, storage, auth, gateway, worker, cli, observe, integration). Public SDK/CLI only; kernel frozen.

events.title: token claims model
events.description: swarm/auth/claims.py: make_claims(user_id, scopes, ttl_seconds=3600) -> dict {sub, scopes: [str], exp: unix}; parse_claims(d) validates presence/types and raises AuthError on missing exp.
acceptance: exp is a future unix timestamp within ttl

events.title: HMAC token sign/verify (stdlib)
events.description: swarm/auth/token.py: issue(secret, claims) -> token string '<b64payload>.<b64sig>' where sig = HMAC-SHA256(secret, payload); verify(secret, token) -> claims dict or raises InvalidToken/TokenExpired. No third-party deps (hmac, hashlib, base64, json).
acceptance: issue then verify returns the claims
